name: HM08
description: Dives underwater the 1st turn, then attacks next turn.

gifts.note: After the Space Center, automatic. Once you have the Mossdeep Gym badge (Badge 7) and have fought off Team Magma at the Mossdeep Space Center with Steven, he invites you home. Walk into his house in Mossdeep City and he gives you HM Dive. It can't be missed.
